sections.title: Owl Statues
sections.note: Strike a statue with your sword to make it a Song of Soaring warp point. Struck statues stay struck through the Song of Time, and you can quit-save (an owl save) at any of them.

items.name: Clock Town
items.howTo: In South Clock Town, the plaza around the Clock Tower.

items.name: Milk Road
items.howTo: On Milk Road, near where Tingle floats.

items.name: Woodfall
items.howTo: On one of the platforms around Woodfall Temple, reached by Deku flower.

items.name: Snowhead
items.howTo: On the path up to Snowhead Temple.

items.name: Ikana Canyon
items.howTo: On the upper level of the canyon, which you reach by freezing the Octoroks in the river with Ice Arrows and Hookshotting up.

items.name: Stone Tower
items.howTo: At Stone Tower, once you've climbed it with the Elegy of Emptiness.

sections.title: Tingle's Maps
sections.note: Pop Tingle's balloon with a bubble, an arrow or the Hookshot, then buy from him. Each Tingle sells his own region's map and the next one's, which costs more. Maps stay through the Song of Time.

items.name: Map of Clock Town
items.howTo: From Tingle in North Clock Town, for 5 Rupees. Tingle in Ikana Canyon sells it too.

items.name: Map of Woodfall
items.howTo: From Tingle on the Road to Southern Swamp, for 20 Rupees. Tingle in North Clock Town sells it too, for more.

items.name: Map of Snowhead
items.howTo: From Tingle on the way to Goron Village. Tingle on the Road to Southern Swamp sells it too.

items.name: Map of Romani Ranch
items.howTo: From Tingle on Milk Road, for 20 Rupees. Tingle in Snowhead sells it too.

items.name: Map of Great Bay
items.howTo: From Tingle on Great Bay Coast. Tingle on Milk Road sells it too.

items.name: Map of Stone Tower
items.howTo: From Tingle in Ikana Canyon. Tingle on Great Bay Coast sells it too.

sections.title: Bank
sections.note: The Clock Town Bank in West Clock Town keeps your deposits through the Song of Time, so its rewards build up over many cycles. Withdrawals cost 4 Rupees at night.

items.name: 200 Rupees deposited
items.area: Clock Town Bank, West Clock Town
items.howTo: Have 200 Rupees in the bank in all.
items.notes: Also on the Wallet row in Items & Equipment.
